hypothesis: The previous model omitted fixed setup for additions and processing of removals and moves. Separating addition presence from request-level work should better explain admission and condensation updates.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures the fixed cost of rebuilding sampling metadata.

pcvs.expression: int(self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed) * (int(not self.all_greedy) + int(not self.no_top_p) + int(not self.no_top_k) + 3 * int(not self.no_penalties) + int(not self.no_allowed_token_ids))
pcvs.name: metadata_tensor_copies
pcvs.rationale: Captures conditional tensor-copy work across sampling configurations.

pcvs.name: has_added_requests
pcvs.rationale: Models fixed logits-processor setup costs when an update contains new requests, which an added-request count alone underestimates.

pcvs.expression: len(self.batch_update_builder.added) + len(self.batch_update_builder.removed) + len(self.batch_update_builder.moved) + (self.num_reqs if self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed and (not self.no_penalties) else 0)
pcvs.name: request_update_work
pcvs.rationale: Combines request-level update processing with the prompt-padding loop, including previously omitted removals and moves.
